title: Travel to Pearl Harbor

paragraphs.text: The ships sailed from Pier E at Long Beach on January 10, 1966, and the landing team reached Pearl Harbor on January 18. The first Pacific crossing took eight elapsed days. After two days in Hawaii, the landing team departed for Okinawa on January 20.
